responsibilities.title: Team coordination and management
responsibilities.body: I lead a 10-person delivery team: 6 developers, 2 QA engineers, 1 product owner and myself as Tech Lead Delivery. My scope includes Agile/Scrum practices and tracking the team’s velocity, quality and cohesion.

responsibilities.title: Backlog, releases and priorities
responsibilities.body: I manage the backlog in Azure DevOps and coordinate business, product, QA and engineering stakeholders. I track releases, risks and priorities for a B2B SaaS platform serving 20,000+ users and 100+ clients, with around two production releases per month.

responsibilities.title: Hiring and engineer development
responsibilities.body: I contribute to technical hiring, onboarding and engineers’ skills development. Code reviews are part of this support, drawing on my software development and technical leadership experience.

responsibilities.title: Quality and continuous improvement
responsibilities.body: I structure shared practices through code standards, living documentation and actionable retrospectives. Monitoring deliverable quality is part of release coordination.

responsibilities.title: Integrating AI into engineering practices
responsibilities.body: I introduced three practices into the team’s workflow: Claude Code-assisted reviews, shared prompts and automated quality checklists. AI supports the work while the team retains responsibility for technical decisions and deliverables.
